messages.text: How do decoder-only LLMs differ from BERT-style encoders?
Decoder-only models are trained autoregressively with causal masking, while BERT-style encoders use bidirectional attention and masked-token objectives.
And what about mixture-of-experts routing?
MoE layers route each token to a few expert MLPs, trading parameter count for compute efficiency.
Thinking about restringing my acoustic guitar with lighter strings.
Lighter gauge strings are easier on the fingers but you may need a truss-rod tweak to avoid fret buzz.
For a brighter tone with light strings, phosphor bronze holds up well.
Can you check my email for anything about my hospital appointment?
Your UZ Gent cardiology appointment is on June 30 at 9:15; Dr. Janssens noted slightly elevated cholesterol and asked for a follow-up blood test.
Mám alergiu na peľ brezy, každú jar potrebujem antihistaminiká.
Poznačil som si: alergia na peľ brezy, sezóna zvyčajne od marca do mája.
The follow-up blood test came back, cholesterol is down to 5.1.
Sťahujeme sa do nového bytu v Petržalke od septembra.
Pri sťahovaní odporúčam prepísať elektrinu a plyn aspoň dva týždne vopred.
Hypotéku sme nakoniec zobrali s fixáciou na päť rokov, úrok 3,8 percenta.
Fixácia na päť rokov pri 3,8 percenta je v dnešnej situácii rozumná voľba.
My rosemary on the balcony is dying — the needles are turning brown from the bottom up.
Brown needles from the bottom usually mean overwatering and root rot; rosemary wants sandy soil and a dry-out between waterings.
I repotted the rosemary into a terracotta pot with drainage like you suggested.
Terracotta breathes better; water only when the top five centimeters of soil are dry.
Booked four nights in Naples for October, mostly for the pizza honestly.
For Naples in October pack light layers; L'Antica Pizzeria da Michele usually has a queue before noon.
Also planning a day trip to Pompeii from Naples.
Rex needs his rabies vaccination renewed before we travel.
The vet clinic on Karadžičova has openings on Thursday; Rex's last rabies shot was in 2024, so the booster is due.
Rex chewed through his leash again, ordering a chain one this time.
A chain leash is heavy; a biothane one resists chewing and weighs less.
We're migrating the billing service from Python to Rust this quarter.
For the billing migration, start with the invoice-generation path — it's the most CPU-bound and benefits most from Rust.
The billing migration deadline moved to the end of November.
If the deadline is end of November, freeze the schema by mid-October.
Mein Sauerteigbrot ist wieder zu dicht geworden, die Krume ist fast wie Kuchen.
Eine dichte Krume liegt meist an zu kurzer Stockgare; versuche 75 Prozent Hydration und eine kalte Übernachtgare im Kühlschrank.
Mit der kalten Übernachtgare ist das Brot endlich luftig geworden, danke.
Nächstes Mal probiere ich Roggenmehl im Sauerteig.
Ich muss noch einen Termin für die Winterreifen machen, am besten Anfang November.
Die Werkstatt im Vlčie hrdlo hat am 4. November freie Termine für den Reifenwechsel.
Termin am 4. November ist gebucht.
Chcem začať investovať do ETF, mesačne okolo dvesto eur.
Pri dvesto eurách mesačne dáva zmysel jeden široký svetový ETF a automatická trvalá objednávka.
Nastavil som trvalý príkaz na prvý deň v mesiaci.
Any good sci-fi films from the last two years I might have missed?
If you liked slower-paced sci-fi, try the one about the generation ship losing its archive — reviewers compared it to early Tarkovsky.
My dentist said the lower left molar needs a crown, scheduled for January 12.
Noted — crown prep on January 12; they usually place a temporary crown for two weeks first.
The temporary crown feels a bit high when I bite.
Robil som kapustnicu podľa babkinej receptúry, s údeným mäsom a hríbmi.
Kapustnica chutí najlepšie na druhý deň; sušené hríby jej dodajú hlbšiu chuť.
Nabudúce skúsim kapustnicu aj s klobásou.
Plánujem cestu do Japonska v apríli, chcem stihnúť čerešňové kvety v Kjóte.
V Kjóte kvitnú čerešne zvyčajne začiatkom apríla; odporúčam rezervovať ubytovanie aspoň tri mesiace vopred.
Kúpil som si JR Pass na sedem dní, shinkansen z Tokia do Kjóta.
Sedemdňový JR Pass sa oplatí, ak ideš aj do Hirošimy alebo Osaky.
Trénujem na polmaratón v Košiciach, zatiaľ zvládnem pätnásť kilometrov.
Do polmaratónu pridávaj maximálne desať percent objemu týždenne a jeden dlhý beh cez víkend.
Dlhý beh v nedeľu bol osemnásť kilometrov, kolená v poriadku.
Ich lese gerade einen Roman über den Zerfall Österreich-Ungarns, sehr atmosphärisch.
Wenn dir das gefällt, könnte dir auch Joseph Roth gefallen, besonders der Radetzkymarsch.
Radetzkymarsch habe ich bestellt.
The rear derailleur on my gravel bike keeps skipping under load.
Skipping under load is usually a worn cassette or a stretched chain — check chain wear with a gauge first.
Chain gauge shows 0.75 wear, replacing the chain and the cassette together.

The fts values also hold by construction (direct queries share exact tokens). Summaries tiers measured 2026-07-10 (e5-small, summary min-cosine 0.78): summaries-hybrid 1.0/1.0 overall AND sk->en — English-canonical summaries close the cross-language gap that caps raw-message hybrid at .50; summaries-fts .375 by construction (5 of 8 queries are lexOverlap:false).
